corrections.reason: The printed glyph is 1st-order አ (አለቀቆም, Amharic 'he/it did not let go'), part of the Amharic commentary before the Ge'ez lemma እስመ ዲበ ኰኵሕ ተሣረረ.
The first character on the line is 7th-order ቆ completing Amharic አለቀቆም, followed by the Ge'ez lemma እስመ ዲበ ኰኵሕ ተሣረረ.
In the Ge'ez citation (cf. Rom 14:9), the verb is 3rd-person masculine singular perfect ተንሥአ (with 6th-order ሥ at the end of L07 and 1st-order አ at the start of L08).
The first letter on L08 is 1st-order አ completing the Ge'ez verb ተንሥአ.
Visually in the image, the glyph after ድ is 1st-order አ (እናናዋውድአ አሉት, cohortative 'let us shake it / make it fall, they said to it'), misread as ሕ.
Both visually in the print and grammatically in Ge'ez (Matt 7:29), the plural noun is ጸሐፍቶሙ with 4th-order ሐ.
Removed spurious Arabic tatweel artifact (ـ) inside የምታስተራኩስ.
